connections.reason: STANAG 4607 (GMTI) from radars and their ground stations, and the simulator's sensor reports to other systems: a TCP client, a TCP server or UDP (a multicast group allowed), in or out, as each link in the settings names it. A server or receiver binds to loopback unless an admin sets another address. The hosts, ports, groups and interfaces come only from the links.

internet.reason: An admin may point a link at a sensor or a ground station on another network. No host is contacted by default; the hosts come only from the links.

dataTypes.name: GMTI detection
dataTypes.description: One target report of a ground moving target indicator radar (STANAG 4607): a detection, not a track.

dataTypes.name: GMTI platform
dataTypes.description: The platform of a GMTI radar (STANAG 4607) and its coverage.

dataTypes.name: GMTI dwell area
dataTypes.description: The area a GMTI radar (STANAG 4607) looked at in one dwell, one per dwell. It fades in steps and goes at its expiry.

fields.name: radialVelocity
fields.label: Radial velocity
fields.description: Speed along the radar's line of sight, away from the sensor positive (D32.7).

fields.name: wrapVelocity
fields.label: Wrap velocity
fields.description: Half the velocity aliasing period: the true radial velocity may differ by a multiple of twice this (D32.8).

fields.name: classification
fields.label: Classification
fields.description: The sensor's target class, its name with its number (D32.10).

fields.name: classProbability
fields.label: Class probability
fields.description: How likely the class is right (D32.11).

fields.name: slantRangeError
fields.label: Slant range error
fields.description: One standard deviation along the radar's slant range (D32.12, else the job's nominal value).

fields.name: crossRangeError
fields.label: Cross range error
fields.description: One standard deviation across the radar's line of sight (D32.13).

fields.name: heightError
fields.label: Height error
fields.description: One standard deviation of the height (D32.14).

fields.name: radialVelocityError
fields.label: Radial velocity error
fields.description: One standard deviation of the radial velocity (D32.15, else the job's nominal value).

fields.name: truthTag
fields.label: Truth tag
fields.description: For simulated targets: the DIS application and entity of the target (D32.16, D32.17).

fields.name: revisitIndex
fields.label: Revisit
fields.description: The revisit of the job's area (D2).

groups.label: Colours
groups.description: The colours of the dwell areas, the coverage and the pairing lines, the same for every user and link.

groups.label: Fading
groups.description: How the detections and the dwell areas fade in steps on every user's map.

links.title: Links
links.description: The GMTI links, one entry per link: each receives STANAG 4607 into a layer (in), or sends the simulator's GMTI sensor reports (out). Without an entry the plugin does nothing. The form shows the fields the link's mode and direction use.

x-emc2.hint: Each link receives STANAG 4607 (in) or sends the simulator's reports (out)

groups.label: Connection
groups.description: The peer the link connects to or sends to, or the address it listens on, with the multicast group.

groups.label: Picture
groups.description: Where an in link's objects go, how its platform is drawn, its times and its coverage.

groups.label: Classification
groups.description: The security label of the link's objects, how a packet's classification maps to it, and what an out link marks its packets with.

groups.label: Advanced
groups.description: When a silent link connects again, and limits on the reports per dwell and per segment.

name.title: Name
name.description: The link's name: lowercase words separated by hyphens, at most 64 characters (e.g. vista). It is the data source of what the link receives, and names its output channel. 'manual' is reserved.

x-emc2.hint: Lower case words with hyphens, e.g. vista; also its data source and channel

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: tcp-client: connects to a sensor, a ground station or a replay that serves 4607 packets over TCP. tcp-server: peers connect to this server. udp: one packet per datagram.

x-emc2.hint: A TCP client of a sender, a TCP server for peers, or UDP

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: in: receives 4607 and writes the platforms, their dwell areas and the detections into the target layer. out: an output channel that sends the simulator's GMTI sensor reports as 4607.

x-emc2.hint: in: draws what it receives; out: sends the simulator's sensor reports

edition.title: Edition
edition.description: out: the STANAG 4607 edition the packets follow. edition-3: STANAG 4607 Edition 3 (2010), version "30". edition-4: AEDP-4607 Edition A Version 1 (STANAG 4607 Edition 4, 2024), version "41", with job ID 0 in packets without a dwell. The bytes are otherwise the same; in links read both.

x-emc2.hint: edition-3 sends version "30" (2010); edition-4 sends "41" (2024)

host.title: Host
host.description: tcp-client: the peer's host. udp out: where to send (a multicast group allowed).

listen.title: Listen on
listen.description: tcp-server and udp in: where to listen. The address defaults to 127.0.0.1 (only this computer); an administrator sets another address, or 0.0.0.0, to listen on the network.

x-emc2.hint: 127.0.0.1 listens on this computer only; 0.0.0.0 on the network

address.title: Address
address.description: The local address to listen on.

port.title: Port
port.description: The local port to listen on.

multicastGroup.title: Multicast group
multicastGroup.description: udp in: the multicast group to join (224.0.0.0 to 239.255.255.255), received on the listen port. Absent: unicast.

x-emc2.hint: A group to join, 224.0.0.0 to 239.255.255.255; empty for unicast

multicastInterface.title: Multicast interface
multicastInterface.description: udp: the network interface that joins the group (in) or sends to it (out), by name or address, e.g. 127.0.0.1 for this computer only. Absent: the system's choice.

x-emc2.hint: The interface for the group, by name or address; empty: the system's

idleSeconds.title: Reconnect when idle
idleSeconds.description: in over TCP: the link connects again when nothing has come for this long. 0: never.

x-emc2.hint: Over TCP: connect again after this long without data; 0: never

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the plugin runs this link.

targetLayer.title: Layer
targetLayer.description: in: where received objects go: an existing layer, or "New layer" with a name. Absent: a new layer named like the link. Two links that name the same new layer share one.

x-emc2.hint: Where the objects go; empty: a new layer named like the link

label.title: Security label
label.description: in: the label of the link's layer, and of objects whose packet's classification is not mapped. out: the least classification a packet says, so that an empty dwell gets it. Default: the server's default label.

x-emc2.hint: The layer's label, and an object's when its packet's is not mapped

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: The classification the policy defines, e.g. UNCLASSIFIED.

platformSymbol.title: Platform symbol
platformSymbol.description: in: the sensor platform's APP-6D symbol code (20 digits); its context follows the packets and its identity the setting below. Absent: from the platform type (fixed wing for aircraft, a sensor for ground based, unknown otherwise).

x-emc2.hint: The platform's APP-6D code, 20 digits; empty: from the platform type

platformIdentity.title: Platform identity
platformIdentity.description: in: the standard identity of the sensor platform's symbol and the colour of its dwell area.

x-emc2.hint: The standard identity of the platform's symbol

maxReportsPerDwell.title: Most reports per dwell
maxReportsPerDwell.description: in: at most this many target reports of one dwell become detections; the rest are skipped and counted.

x-emc2.hint: A dwell's reports beyond this are skipped and counted

time.title: Time
time.description: in: as-recorded keeps the packets' times; as-received shifts every time of the link by one offset, so that its newest dwell is now (for replays of old recordings).

x-emc2.hint: as-received shifts a recording's times so that its newest dwell is now

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: in: map gives the objects the packet's classification (P4), named by the names below; link-label gives every object the link's label.

x-emc2.hint: map: the packet's classification by the names below; link-label: the link's

classificationNames.title: Classification names
classificationNames.description: The policy's classifications for the packet's classification 1 (top secret) to 5 (unclassified). Default: NATO's.

x-emc2.hint: The names of classifications 1 (top secret) to 5 (unclassified)

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: in: draws each sensor's coverage, the job definition's bounding area, as a dashed outline beside its dwell area. Off: none is drawn, and a drawn one is removed.

x-emc2.hint: Draws each sensor's coverage, its job's bounding area, dashed

highestClassification.title: Highest classification
highestClassification.description: out: detections above it are not sent. Absent: the highest classification of the label's policy.

x-emc2.hint: Detections above it are not sent; empty: the policy's highest

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: The classification the policy defines, e.g. UNCLASSIFIED.

nationality.title: Nationality
nationality.description: out: the nationality and classification system of the packets (P3, P5), two capital letters; XN is NATO.

x-emc2.hint: Two capital letters: the packets' nationality and system; XN is NATO

exercise.title: Exercise
exercise.description: out: marks the packets as exercise data (P7 129) instead of operation (P7 1); simulated either way.

x-emc2.hint: Marks the packets as exercise data instead of operation

maxReportsPerSegment.title: Most reports per segment
maxReportsPerSegment.description: out: at most this many target reports per dwell segment; a larger dwell goes as several segments of the same dwell.

x-emc2.hint: A larger dwell goes as several segments of the same dwell

oneSegmentPerPacket.title: One segment per packet
oneSegmentPerPacket.description: out: sends each segment (the mission, the job definition, each dwell segment) in a packet of its own with its own packet header, for receivers that read only a packet's first segment. Off: one packet per sensor report.

x-emc2.hint: Each segment in a packet of its own, for receivers that read only one

dwellAreaColour.title: Dwell area colour
dwellAreaColour.description: The colour of the solid outline of the dwell areas the GMTI links receive: fixed, the colour below, by default #7EF26A; identity, the platform identity's colour, as each link's platformIdentity gives it. The same for every user and link; a change applies from each sensor's next dwell, not to the areas already drawn. The Simulation's own dwells follow Settings › Simulator.

x-emc2.hint: The dwell areas' outline, for every user, from each sensor's next dwell

coverageColour.title: Coverage colour
coverageColour.description: The colour of the dashed outline of the coverage the GMTI links receive, a job's bounding area: fixed, the colour below, by default #BDCF3D; identity, the platform identity's colour, as each link's platformIdentity gives it. The same for every user and link; a change applies from each coverage's next write, within 30 s while its sensor sends. The Simulation's own coverage follows Settings › Simulator.

x-emc2.hint: The coverage's dashed outline, a job's bounding area, for every user

pairingColour.title: Pairing line colour
pairingColour.description: The colour of every GMTI Pairing line, from a sensor to what it detected: the GMTI links' and the Simulation's sensors' alike. #RRGGBB. The same for every user; the map follows a change at once, without a reload. Whether a user sees the lines is the user's display setting GMTI Pairing.

x-emc2.hint: Every GMTI Pairing line, the Simulation's too; the map follows at once

detectionFade.title: Detection fade
detectionFade.description: The detections fade in steps on every user's map, from each detection's time: fully drawn until From, then one Step less every (Invisible at − From) × Step / 100 s, not drawn from Invisible at, which must be above From. Defaults: 95 % from 14.5 s, 50 % from 55 s, gone at 100 s. An invisible detection stays until its data type removes it. A change shows at once. Off: only the data type's fade at expiry. A link whose time is as recorded gives old detections their old times: invisible at once.

x-emc2.hint: How the detections fade in steps on every map, counted from their time

on.title: Fade in steps
on.description: On: the detections fade in steps as set below.

fromSeconds.title: From (s)
fromSeconds.description: Seconds after a detection's time at which it starts to fade.

stepPercent.title: Step (%)
stepPercent.description: How much less each step draws, in percent of full.

invisibleAtSeconds.title: Invisible at (s)
invisibleAtSeconds.description: Seconds after a detection's time from which it is not drawn; above From.

dwellAreaFade.title: Dwell area fade
dwellAreaFade.description: The dwell areas fade in steps on every user's map, from each dwell's time, as Detection fade does: fully drawn until From, then one Step less every (Invisible at − From) × Step / 100 s, not drawn from Invisible at, which must be above From. Each dwell has its own area. Defaults: 95 % from 5.5 s, 50 % from 10 s, gone at 15 s. An invisible area stays until its data type removes it. A change shows at once. Off: only the data type's fade at expiry. The platform and its coverage do not fade in steps.

x-emc2.hint: How the dwell areas fade in steps on every map, from their dwell's time

on.title: Fade in steps
on.description: On: the dwell areas fade in steps as set below.

fromSeconds.title: From (s)
fromSeconds.description: Seconds after a dwell's time at which its area starts to fade.

stepPercent.title: Step (%)
stepPercent.description: How much less each step draws, in percent of full.

invisibleAtSeconds.title: Invisible at (s)
invisibleAtSeconds.description: Seconds after a dwell's time from which its area is not drawn; above From.
